domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite unlike fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when denominators differ and the solver finds an LCD or other common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to create like denominators before subtraction.
Tag in mixed-number problems when only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that create forms like 12/12 or 24/24 from one whole during subtraction.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a mixed form with 0 fractional part.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite an operand into a subtraction-ready equivalent form, including normalizing a mixed number with an improper fractional part or rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a needed denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is rewritten as an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole part plus 0 over a chosen denominator to align forms for subtraction.
Tag only when the representation changes without yet performing the subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion between nonzero fractions; that is S01.
Do not tag borrowing one whole into denominator-over-denominator form after subtraction has begun; that is S04.
Do not tag merely identifying existing whole and fractional parts without changing the representation.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts are subtracted separately in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when subtraction produces an intermediate zero or negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step of creating common denominators.
Do not tag operand normalization done before subtraction begins.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping used to resolve a negative or insufficient fractional part.

skills.name: Borrow in subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as denominator-over-denominator fractional units and adjust the whole part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative or insufficient.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver borrows 1 from the whole part during mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
Tag when one whole is converted into forms like 3/3, 5/5, 12/12, or 24/24 and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when regrouping is used after an initial subtraction shows a negative or too-small fractional part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction can be completed without regrouping.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as whole plus 0 over a denominator before subtraction; that is S02.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and remove any zero fractional part so the answer is expressed in simplest form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by a common factor.
Tag when a result such as 0/3 is rewritten as 0 or when a mixed number with 0 fractional part is rewritten as a whole number.
Tag when the final result is rewritten into simplest acceptable mixed-number, fraction, or integer form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction step that produced the unsimplified result.
Do not tag merely combining already simplified nonzero whole and fractional parts into one mixed number.
Do not tag normalization or borrowing steps.
